ACT XLIII OF 2020
PRISONS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act further to amend the Prisons Act, 1894
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
9th November, 2020]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills-124 / 2020/11601, dated 9.11.2020.---The Prisons (Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 27th October, 2020
and assented to by the Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 4th November, 2020
is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Prisons Act, 1894 (Act No. IX of 1894),
for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as
follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Prisons (Amendment) Act, 2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 59 of the Act No. IX of 1894

passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 27th October, 2020
and assented to by the Governor of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 4th November, 2020
is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa.
WHEREAS
it is expedient further to amend the Prisons Act, 1894 (Act No. IX of 1894),
for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as
follows:
2. Amendment
of section 59 of the Act No. IX of 1894.---In the Prisons Act, 1894 (Act No. IX of 1894), in section 59, in
clause (27), the word "and", appearing at the end, shall be deleted and
thereafter the following new clauses shall respectively be inserted, namely:
"(27-i)
regulating the use of arms or force or restraints against persons, objects or
vehicles to defend the prison, prisoners, prison property, vehicles or prison
personnel;
(27-ii)
establishing and regulating prison industries, inside the prisons for skill
development and vocational training of the prisoners;
(27-iii)
raising and maintaining the welfare fund of the prisons, consisting of the
profit of sale proceeds of articles, manufactured in prison industry, profit of
tuck shops, Public Call Offices and sale proceeds of dry bread and any other
income, grant or donation, to be utilized by the office of Inspector General of
Prisons for the welfare of the prisoners and the prison staff and improvement
of living and working condition in Prisons and precincts; and".
